column3: Kuroneko Route · Belief and Pride
This is my own decision.
It's something that I've decided to finish, with my spirit, belief and pride on the line.
So please, speak no further.
...But you know, isn't this slightly different since people are worried about you?
Imagine collapsing and getting sent to a hospital. Kirino, Saori and the members of the club would be worried sick about you.
If you aren't careful, the club activities could very well be suspended because of that too.
...And? Haven't I told you before? I'm not obliged to listen to your words.
...You're like a little sister to me.
Isn't it natural for me, a brother, to take care of you?
...I see.
Kirino has said this before. You're an untamed cat, so it's necessary to be overbearing.
Heh, that's something a girl who doesn't know anything would say...
And what of it? Isn't it better for you to back off before you get scratched?
True, it did hurt. Being scratched by you the last time.
Yes, that's right. You're too bothersome, so I had to bare my claws.
But, despite all that pain...
It puts me a million times more at ease than seeing you fall.
Wha-...
Compared to that, your claws are just a mere plaything.
I've become tough! I won't be driven away by your claws!
That's why I'll use any methods to stop you the next time you're being reckless again. I hope you're prepared!
*sigh*
Good grief... you are such a...
That's right. The thick-skinned mortals in this world live without any sense of shame...
Hey you...
I guess I won't be scratching you the next time, but biting you instead...?
I'm quite happy if you would rather bite me. Your face will be closer to me, at least.
You're really beyond all hope...
It's fine to be worry about others, but how about considering your 【Own Future】 for a bit?
Then don't let me worry about you too much.
But isn't that just you taking matters into your own hands?
Well, I guess that's true.
That's about it. That's all I want to say.
I'll be leaving then.
It's fine the way it is now. My worries won't be wasted as long as I'm able to help her a little.
If she's going to be reckless again, I'll stop her before she collapses.
Ah...
...Hmm?
...H-Hold on.
What is it?
Hmm? What's wrong?
The... oracle just now...
Hey, what's wrong with you, Kuroneko? What oracle are you talking about?
I would like to have a life counseling session.
Heh... Hahaha.
Stop laughing. I'm being serious.
I'm being serious here as well. Life counseling, you say?
I never expected that from you.
I've heard it long ago from her. She said it with a sense of pride too. I'm sure you'll listen to what I have to say if I were to put it this way, will you not?
So... could you listen to my troubles?
Of course, bring it on!
And with that, Kuroneko's life counseling session started.
I didn't really think the situation would develop this way.
...I've been drawing the event's manuscript, all by myself.
I just want to confirm how far I could go by my own right now...
But it seems I can't finish by the deadline if this goes on.
That's why... could you help me out?
This is my first time seeing such an honest and docile Kuroneko... I mean...
Haha, isn't it the same as the suggestion I gave before?
...Right. Just for now, I'll admit it. I was being stubborn before.
Is it all right like this? ...And? Will you accept?
Of course I will.
Since you've put it that way, I'll help you no matter what.
I see... Then starting from tomorrow, I'll be counting on you.
Yeah, please do.
Good grief, we have made a very big detour... However, this detour... seems to have some merit?
